# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built. The list is in sections (N64Recomp-browser's
# README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders"): the lines above the first "section" line are the boot, built before
# the game starts, and each section after it is built when the game first draws with 4 of its shaders, the game waiting
# for it in Firefox (Chrome builds the whole list behind the game, a section at a time). A description can be in several
# sections. One missing here is built behind the game when it is first drawn, and the page remembers it for the next
# visit; until then RT64 draws it with its ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford.
#
# Recorded from the page opened with ?record-shaders, which prints every description RT64 meets, at the page's default
# settings, by tools/shader_plan.json with N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs (its "files" section merged
# here into title): the boot is the Rareware logo and the band's intro; title is the title over Spiral Mountain and
# its flyovers for 2.5 minutes, and the file select screen; game is a new game's opening cutscene and Spiral Mountain
# outside Banjo's house. rest is what an earlier recording, played by hand, met beyond those: about ten minutes of the
# attract mode's demos, Spiral Mountain (Banjo's house inside, Bottles, the moat), the pause menu, the totals screen,
# Save and Quit with its game over sequence. The last five sections are places the plan reaches by code, by
# tools/warp.js from Spiral Mountain, and played about 25 s each (the plan's header says how): ttc, Treasure Trove Cove
# and its sandcastle, Clanker's Cavern and inside Clanker, Bubblegloop Swamp; fp, Freezeezy Peak and its Christmas
# tree, Gobi's Valley, Rubee's chamber and the water pyramid; mmm, Mad Monster Mansion and its church, Rusty Bucket
# Bay; grunty, Furnace Fun and the battlements with Gruntilda's fight; ending, the ending's cutscene maps. Each holds
# what a long play of those places drew that the sections above lack. Not yet: Gruntilda's Lair between the worlds,
# the worlds' other rooms, Mumbo's transformations, flying, the other bosses. Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR,
# MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
